data.subtitle: There's a better way to debug

data.caption: Half your lines are debug noise

data.from:
console.log('payment', payment)
console.log('user', user)
console.log('inventory result:', inventory)
data.to:
const logger = createLogger('orders')
logger.info('payment processed', { payment })
logger.info('user loaded', { userId: user.id })
logger.debug('inventory check', { inventory })
data.caption: Structured logging > console.log

left.label: console.log

right.label: Structured Logger

[orders] INFO: payment processed

data.caption: Searchable, filterable, useful

data.text: console.log is for prototyping. Structured logging is for production.
